meta.swap_source: Hirose LION FX published swap table
meta.swap_normalization: sell_yen / published accrual days; 0-day rows have no per-day value
meta.description: Hirose USD/TRY sell swap with fixed-time FX-cost intervals
meta.market_rate_source: Yahoo Finance chart API: USDTRY=X and USDJPY=X
meta.market_rate_method: same timestamp 1h close at 23:00 JST; fallback to nearest earlier common hour within 3h
meta.fx_cost_method: current fixed-time USDTRY to next Hirose-row fixed-time USDTRY, converted at next-row TRYJPY
meta.fx_cost_daily_method: interval FX cost divided by elapsed calendar days
meta.fx_cost_sign: positive=FX loss for USDTRY short; negative=FX gain
